name: plataforma-orientacion-comunidad
description: Prototipo (TRL 4, datos sintéticos) de orientación y comunidad protegida para jóvenes de Villavicencio.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k -n db,backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run db:local -w apps/backend" "npm run dev:esperando-db -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend"
scripts.dev:distribuido: concurrently -k -n backendA,backendB,frontend -c cyan,blue,magenta "npm run dev:instancia -w apps/backend -- 4000" "npm run dev:instancia -w apps/backend -- 4001" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend"
scripts.verificar: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
